lines.en: label nodokathontwo3:
scene paganlust2
Exposed like the whole-bodied weak point I am, I take a moment to close my eyes and reflect on myself as the fruits of my daughter fall from my branch.
lines.zh: 像我这样浑身都是弱点的存在被彻底袒露在外，我趁这片刻闭上眼睛审视自己，任我女儿的果实从我的枝头坠落。

lines.en: I remember things I’ve been taught. The true reasons why Sodom & Gomorrah fell and how I, too, would be a pillar of salt if not for this false prophecy.
lines.zh: 我想起别人教过我的东西。索多玛与蛾摩拉真正毁灭的原因，以及若不是因为这道虚假的预言，我自己也会变成一根盐柱。

lines.en: Yet here I stand, torch in hand and teary-eyed — not for the lives that have been lost but for those who came before them.
lines.zh: 然而我此刻站在这里，手持火炬、热泪盈眶——不是为那些逝去的生命，而是为那些走在他们之前的人。

lines.en: Those who created something and unleashed it upon the world with hopes it will find fulfillment. Or purpose. Or anything to make a mark.
lines.zh: 那些创造了某样东西、将它释放到世界上、盼着它能得到圆满的人。或者找到意义。或者留下任何一点痕迹。

lines.en: I was created with this in mind too.
lines.zh: 我也是抱着这样的念头被造出来的。

lines.en: I was meant to be something.
lines.zh: 我本该成为某种东西。

lines.en: But I was led into temptation by those who trespassed against us and I find myself now not being delivered {i}from{/i} temptation but led directly into its arms.
lines.zh: 可我被那些冒犯过我们的人引向了诱惑，如今我发现自己并没有{i}脱离{/i}诱惑，而是被径直送进了它的怀抱。

lines.en: I am no god-king — just a smooth-talking snake who hides in places where no one but a {i}real{/i} god would be able to step on him.
lines.zh: 我不是什么神王——只是一条巧舌如簧的蛇，躲在除了{i}真神{/i}之外谁也踩不到他的地方。

lines.en: She’s returning. Not she or her, but {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 她回来了。不是这个她，也不是那个她，而是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: I have drowned out everything else, but have yet to find a way to free myself not from the voices in my head, but a longing for their company now that they have left me.
lines.zh: 我已经把其他一切都屏蔽掉了，却始终找不到办法解脱——不是从脑海里的声音中解脱，而是从她们离去之后、对她们陪伴的渴望中解脱。

lines.en: scene paganlust1
If she were but a voice, I wonder how much I’d change. I wonder if having her inside of me would offer up the same comfort I get when she absolves me of my sins.
lines.zh: 如果她只是一个声音，我不知道自己会改变多少。我不知道让她进入我体内，会不会带来与她赦免我的罪时同样的慰藉。

lines.en: With her guidance, perhaps I {i}could{/i} be a god.
lines.zh: 在她的指引下，我或许{i}能{/i}成为神。

lines.en: Maybe then I could truly be forgotten one day.
lines.zh: 也许那样的话，有一天我就能真正被遗忘。

lines.en: It’s just hard to do that when you can’t ever leave.
lines.zh: 只是在你永远无法离开的情况下，这很难做到。

lines.en: : Put this on, Akira.
lines.zh: : 把这个戴上，Akira。

lines.en: scene paganlust3
: ...a blindfold?
: There’s a taxi waiting for you just outside of this room. It will take you to the final trial...and I don’t want those beautiful eyes of yours spoiling the surprise.
lines.zh: : 房间外面有辆出租车在等您。它会把您送去最后一项试炼……而我不想让您那双漂亮的眼睛提前破坏惊喜。

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei is leaving? Then what are {i}we{/i} supposed to-
lines.zh: : 等等，老师要走了？那{i}我们{/i}该——

lines.en: : I’ll get to that in a moment. For now, {i}Akira,{/i} I need you to do as I say. We’ve barely accomplished anything in this chapter of our story, and I’m looking to change that.
lines.zh: : 那件事我稍后再说。现在，{i}Akira{/i}，我需要您照我说的做。在我们故事的这一章里，我们几乎什么都没做成，而我想改变这一点。

lines.en: : Do you trust me?
lines.zh: : 您信任我吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不信任。

lines.en: : Good. You {i}shouldn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 很好。您本就{i}不该{/i}信任。

lines.en: : You’re getting something out of this. More than just the enjoyment of watching me crumble.
lines.zh: : 你从这里面得到了什么。不只是看着我崩溃的乐趣。

lines.en: : Indeed, I am. But what is it, do you think?
lines.zh: : 确实。可您觉得那是什么？

lines.en: : A feeling...
lines.zh: : 一种感觉……

lines.en: : Oh?
: That’s it...
lines.zh: : 就是这样……

lines.en: : That’s all you’re getting...
lines.zh: : 你只能得到这么多了……

lines.en: : If only you were my father, Akira.
lines.zh: : 要是您是我父亲就好了，Akira。

lines.en: : If only I had one at all.
lines.zh: : 要是我有父亲就好了。

lines.en: : Now, please-
lines.zh: : 那么，请——

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah, sure. You already know I don’t require much persuasion when there’s sex involved.
lines.zh: : 行吧，当然。你早知道只要扯上性，我根本不需要怎么被说服。

lines.en: : I just hope that whatever you have in store next doesn’t ruin anyone else’s night.
lines.zh: : 我只希望你接下来安排的东西，不会毁掉其他任何人的夜晚。

lines.en: : But we’re all having so much fun...aren’t we, girls?
lines.zh: : 可我们都玩得很开心……对吧，姑娘们？

lines.en: Miku and Ami begin to clap for a moment, but stop once the other two don’t feed into the noise.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Ami 起劲地鼓了一会儿掌，但见另外两人没有跟着起哄，也就停了下来。

lines.en: : Have fun, Dad! Just not too much fun since neither of your daughters will be there for it.
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，爸爸！不过别太开心，毕竟您的两个女儿都不在场。

lines.en: : Right...Have a good night, everyone. And thanks for...worshipping me or whatever.
lines.zh: : 好……祝大家晚安。还有谢谢你们……崇拜我什么的。

lines.en: : Anytime, Sensei! And don’t worry about me blabbin’ to anybody about this since Nodoka made me sign a contract.
lines.zh: : 随时乐意，老师！别担心我会到处乱说，Nodoka 让我签了合同的。

lines.en: : As if that’ll stop you from doing it accidentally.
lines.zh: : 那也拦不住你一不小心说漏嘴吧。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta become Nodoka’s sex slave if I reveal anythin’ and that sounds scary as hell, so I think I’m gonna try a little harder than normal this time.
lines.zh: : 我要是泄露半句就得成为 Nodoka 的性奴，那听起来吓死人了，所以这次我打算比平时多努力一点。

lines.en: : Wait, was that actually in the contract?
lines.zh: : 等等，合同里真的写了那条？

lines.en: : Not in Kirin’s as I imagined she’d have broken it on purpose.
lines.zh: : Kirin 的合同里没有，因为我猜她会故意违约。

lines.en: : Tch.
: But for the rest of-
lines.zh: : 可其他人的——

lines.en: : Again, we’ll have more time to talk in a moment. I need to escort Akira now. Akira-
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我们待会儿有的是时间聊。我现在得护送 Akira。Akira——

lines.en: : Yeah. Lead the way. Not like I can see anything.
lines.zh: : 好。带路吧。反正我也什么都看不见。

lines.en: : It shall be done.
lines.zh: : 遵命。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I’m led into the back of a taxi and buckled in without so much as a word from the driver. He probably already knows where we’re headed.
lines.zh: 我被领进出租车后座、扣好安全带，司机一句话都没说。他大概早就知道我们要去哪儿。

lines.en: Nodoka does say one thing, though.
lines.zh: 不过 Nodoka 确实说了一句话。

lines.en: She whispers-
lines.zh: 她低声说道——

lines.en: : {i}If God is real, we will find out tonight when He punishes us for all the sins we’ve committed.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果上帝真的存在，今晚我们就会知道——当祂为我们犯下的所有罪惩罚我们的时候。{/i}

lines.en: : And if He doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 如果祂不存在呢？

lines.en: : If he {i}doesn’t...{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果祂{i}不存在{/i}……

lines.en: : We are stuck here forever.
lines.zh: : 我们就永远困在这里了。

lines.en: scene black
scene paganlust4
: Many believe that is the duty of those who are living to live for God — and to abstain from sexual immorality so the creator alone can be the one to maintain control.
lines.zh: : 许多人相信，活着的人的职责就是为上帝而活——并且远离性方面的不洁，好让造物主独自维持掌控。

lines.en: : {size=-2}We’re told to not take advantage of our brothers or our sisters, but what these arbitrary rules neglect to take into consideration is that {i}we{/i} are being taken advantage of in being told to do anything at all.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我们被告诫不可占弟兄姐妹的便宜，可这些武断的规矩忽略了一点：光是被要求去做任何事，{i}我们{/i}本身就已经在被占便宜了。{/size}

lines.en: : Yet He calls upon us to be pure. To refrain from doing anything that others would see as an act of unholiness because it somehow makes {i}Him{/i} look bad when all is said and done.
lines.zh: : 然而祂召唤我们要纯洁。要我们不做任何在他人眼中不圣洁的事——因为到头来那多少会让{i}祂{/i}面上无光。

lines.en: : But how does that make {i}us{/i} look, sisters?
lines.zh: : 可那又让{i}我们{/i}看起来像什么，姐妹们？

lines.en: : Should we simply accept the theoretical bullshit that portrays {i}us{/i} as weak while a divine entity bawls from atop his throne at the mere idea of us exercising our free will?
lines.zh: : 难道{i}我们{/i}就该默默接受那套把我们描绘成弱者的理论废话，任由一个神圣存在坐在王座上，仅仅因为想到我们在行使自由意志就嚎啕大哭？

lines.en: : Be immoral. Be impure. Be {i}free.{/i} And bask in the fruits of your autonomy as it is that {i}exact{/i} thing that serves not just as a rejection of God, but as the formation of your own.
lines.zh: : 不道德吧。不纯洁吧。{i}自由{/i}吧。去沐浴你们自主权的果实——因为那{i}恰恰{/i}不只是对上帝的拒绝，更是你们自身神格的成形。

lines.en: scene paganlust5
: It is {i}we{/i} who shape this world as {i}we{/i} are the ones who inhabit it. And just because we do not {i}yet{/i} understand it does not mean that we {i}can’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 塑造这个世界的是{i}我们{/i}，因为居住在其中的是{i}我们{/i}。我们{i}尚未{/i}理解它，并不意味着我们{i}无法{/i}理解。

lines.en: : Gone are the days of being told to work with our hands or lead quiet lives. And gone are the days of losing ourself in words when there are words all around us begging to be led astray.
lines.zh: : 被吩咐要亲手劳作、要安静度日的日子已经过去了。迷失于词语中的日子也已经过去——如今环绕我们的词语，全都在乞求被引入歧途。

lines.en: : They tell us not to be dependent, yet they force us to depend on them. And they see not the fallacy of this, just gospel. Because {i}that’s the way it is.{/i} That’s what {i}God{/i} wants.
lines.zh: : 他们告诉我们要独立，却又逼我们依赖他们。他们看不见其中的谬误，只看见福音。因为事情{i}本就如此{/i}。因为那是{i}上帝{/i}的旨意。

lines.en: : But that’s boring.
lines.zh: : 可那太无聊了。

lines.en: : It is {i}all{/i} so fucking boring.
lines.zh: : 这{i}一切{/i}都他妈的无聊透顶。

lines.en: scene paganlust6
: Uhh...what are we looking at here?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们这是在看着什么？

lines.en: : Interesting choice of decor. A room with no beds or couches, just two kids’ chairs and a picnic table.
lines.zh: : 装潢选择挺有意思。一间没有床也没有沙发的房间，只有两把儿童椅和一张野餐桌。

lines.en: : Does God hate picnics or something?
lines.zh: : 上帝是不是讨厌野餐之类的？

lines.en: : Probably if He’s as much of a buzzkill as Nodoka’s makin’ him sound.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，如果祂真像 Nodoka 说的那么扫兴的话。

lines.en: : What you see is an ordinary room where something {i}extraordinary{/i} is about to happen.
lines.zh: : 你们眼前是一间普通的房间，而一件{i}非同寻常{/i}的事即将在这里发生。

lines.en: scene paganlust7
: {i}All we must do now is wait for our contestants to arrive...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们现在要做的，就是等我们的参赛者登场……{/i}

lines.en: : Is this really the right place?...
lines.zh: : 这里真的是正确的地方吗？……

lines.en: : I get wanting to be discreet, but why would Molly make me come all the way to the Old District to-
lines.zh: : 想低调一点我懂，可 Molly 为什么非要我大老远跑到旧城区来——

lines.en: : Haruka?
lines.zh: : Haruka？

lines.en: scene paganlust8

lines.zh: : 什——Sara？！呃……嗨！

lines.en: : What are you doing over here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : What...are {i}you{/i} doing over here?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene paganlust9
: I’m...helping Sana...with her grades...
lines.zh: : 我……在帮 Sana……补习功课……

lines.en: : By...coming to the slums in the middle of the night? How is that-
lines.zh: : 靠……半夜跑到这种地方来？这怎么——

lines.zh: : 我……是约好在这里见老师的。

lines.en: scene paganlust10
: Have you talked to him at all? Is {i}he{/i} the one who invited you over? Did that guy seriously sign us up for a threesome without informing either one of us?
lines.zh: : 你跟他聊过吗？是{i}他{/i}叫你来的？那家伙真的给我们俩都报了名搞三人行，却连个招呼都不打？

lines.en: : No, I haven’t talked to him at all. I came here to meet someone else.
lines.zh: : 没有，我根本没跟他说过话。我是来见别人的。

lines.en: scene paganlust11
: Someone else? Did you, like...did you meet someone {i}online?{/i} Or...
lines.zh: : 别人？你……你是在{i}网上{/i}认识的人吗？还是……

lines.en: : Y...Yeah! Just an...online friend. We were, like...going to go out to eat and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 是……是啊！就是个……网友。我们本来……要去吃饭什么的……对。

lines.en: : Interesting...outfit for a dinner date.
lines.zh: : 吃晚饭穿这身……挺有意思。

lines.en: scene paganlust12
: Hahah...yeah! Seems like he stood me up, though, soooo...guess I’ll just go home and...see you later!
lines.zh: : 哈哈……是啊！不过他好像放我鸽子了，所——以……那我就先回家了……回头见！

lines.en: : You don’t have to lie to me, Haruka. I don’t own the guy and...I never thought we were exclusive, so...I’m not gonna get mad at you for coming out here to see him.
lines.zh: : 你不用对我撒谎，Haruka。他又不是我的私有物，而且……我从没觉得我们是专属关系，所以……我不会因为你跑来见他就生气。

lines.en: scene paganlust13
: I...I mean...yeah, but...I really...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我……我是说……对，可是……我真的……呃……

lines.en: : How do I...say this without sounding...horrible?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么……说才不会听起来……很糟糕？

lines.en: : Tell you what, why don’t we head inside and make Sensei explain this to us directly?
lines.zh: : 这样吧，我们为什么不进去，让老师亲自给我们解释清楚？

lines.en: scene paganlust14

lines.zh: : 因为让一个女孩的{i}妈妈{/i}用身体换分数是一回事。可连她的朋友也算上？{i}那就{/i}过分了。

lines.en: : Sara, you don’t...you don’t think this is weird at all? That...we were asked to come all the way out {i}here{/i} for...the stuff we were invited here for?
lines.zh: : Sara，你不……你不觉得这很奇怪吗？我们……被叫大老远跑来{i}这里{/i}，就为了……他们请我们来的那档子事？

lines.en: : Of course it’s weird. Sensei's been out of school for so long he probably doesn't even {i}know{/i} Sana's grades.
lines.zh: : 当然奇怪。老师离开学校那么久了，他大概连 Sana 的成绩是多少都不{i}知道{/i}。

lines.en: : But it’s not like I can just refuse my daughter the {i}one{/i} time she actually asks me for help with something.
lines.zh: : 可我总不能拒绝我女儿难得{i}一次{/i}开口求我帮忙吧。

lines.en: : So Sana is...the one who asked you to come? She...put you up to having sex with her teacher?
lines.zh: : 所以是 Sana……叫你来的？是她……怂恿你跟她的老师上床？

lines.en: scene paganlust15

lines.zh: : 这很能说明她心里到底怎么看我的，对吧？哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : It’s just...it seems kinda...{i}forward.{/i} Don’t you-
lines.zh: : 只是……这好像有点……太{i}直接{/i}了。你不——

lines.en: : Can we just...go inside? This area...
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……先进去？这一带……

lines.en: : It really gives me the creeps...
lines.zh: : 真的让我浑身发毛……

lines.en: scene black

lines.zh: : 呃……嗯……好。我们是……直接上去敲门还是——

lines.zh: : Sana 让我直接进去。而且门好像开着，所以——

lines.en: scene paganlust16
: Oh look, something’s finally happening. That’s not...Sana {i}or{/i} Molly, though.
lines.zh: : 哦瞧，总算有动静了。不过那不是……Sana {i}或{/i} Molly。

lines.en: : Wait...isn’t that-
lines.zh: : 等等……那不是——

lines.en: : The slutty cafe lady who’s cheating on her husband with my dad? Sure is.
lines.zh: : 那个背着老公跟我爸乱搞的咖啡店骚货？没错就是她。

lines.en: : That’s...Sara too...{i}Sara’s{/i} there.
lines.zh: : 还有……Sara 也在……{i}Sara{/i} 在那儿。

lines.en: : Nodoka, why is Sana’s mom now being roped into a competition that-
lines.zh: : Nodoka，为什么 Sana 的妈妈也被卷进这场比赛里——

lines.en: : Shh...
scene paganlust17

lines.zh: : 一切很快就会揭晓。

lines.en: : It’d be no fun if I gave everything away, would it?

lines.zh: : 可为什么是{i}她{/i}？！Sara 人很好！她不该被卷进这种事！

lines.zh: : 我……{i}真的{/i}很喜欢她。

lines.zh: : 要生气的话，去生你同学们的气。我只是架好了摄像机、定好了规则而已。

lines.en: scene paganlust18
: And what {i}are{/i} those rules? Is Sensei going to walk in there any minute now? Do we have to watch him with {i}them{/i} next? Where we can’t interfere?
lines.zh: : 那规则是什么？老师随时会走进去吗？我们接下来就得看着他和{i}她们{/i}做？还不能插手？

lines.en: : My- it’d be quite the plot twist if he showed up, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哎呀——如果他真的出现了，那可真是神来一笔的剧情反转，不是吗？

lines.en: : Would it? That’s kind of where I assumed this was heading.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我本来还以为事情就是往那个方向发展的。

lines.zh: : 我们他妈的怎么可能知道？你大半夜有一半时间都在背那些阴森的圣经故事。我们谁都不知道你脑子里在想什么。

lines.en: : Mm.
: I’m not sure things would be much better if you could.
lines.zh: : 就算你们知道了，我也不确定情况会好多少。

lines.en: scene black
: All of you can go home. I’ll clean up here.
lines.zh: : 你们都可以回家了。这里我来收拾。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want us to-
lines.zh: : 你确定不要我们——

lines.en: : Leave...
lines.zh: : 走吧……

lines.en: : Just...leave...
scene clearnightsky
In the end, I never found out what the last competition was.
lines.zh: 到最后，我始终没搞清楚最后一场比赛是什么。

lines.en: It seemed like just another threesome to me. Albeit with...smaller participants.
lines.zh: 在我看来，那似乎又不过是一场三人行。只不过……参与者小了点。

lines.en: But as we left the love hotel and headed back to the lonely one, I saw a hint of disappointment in each of their eyes.
lines.zh: 但在我们离开情人酒店、回到那孤独之人的身边时，我从她们每个人的眼里看到了一丝失望。

lines.en: {size=-1}I couldn’t bring myself to ask what it was — just as they couldn’t bring themselves to ask why {i}I{/i} was the one who ultimately pulled the plug on an act that could have gone on all night.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}我没能开口问那是什么——就像她们也没能开口问我，为什么最终是{i}我{/i}拔掉了插头，结束了这场本可以持续一整夜的事。{/size}

lines.en: I guess we all have things we want to keep to ourselves, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我们都有些想独自藏着的东西。

lines.en: Some more than others.
lines.zh: 有些人藏得比别人多。

lines.en: It all depends on how much we’re willing to trust.
lines.zh: 这取决于我们愿意信任到什么程度。

lines.en: And how painful it is to pull an arrow out of your body when you could just let it sit there and hold its own wound shut.
lines.zh: 也取决于把箭从身体里拔出来有多疼——毕竟你也可以就让它留在那儿，用它自己堵住那道伤口。

lines.en: scene black
From a hotel bed, just after parting with Sana and Molly, I send a text to Nodoka asking for an explanation.
lines.zh: 在酒店的床上，刚和 Sana、Molly 分开不久，我给 Nodoka 发了条短信，要求她给个解释。

lines.en: She doesn’t respond.
lines.zh: 她没有回复。

lines.en: I send her another — asking if this was really {i}just{/i} for fun.
lines.zh: 我又发了一条——问她这一切是不是真的{i}只是{/i}为了好玩。

lines.en: Again, nothing.
lines.zh: 依旧，什么也没有。

lines.en: So I send her a third, and I tell her I’m in pain. A pain that only she can cure.
lines.zh: 于是我发了第三条，告诉她我很痛。一种只有她能治愈的痛。

lines.en: An hour later, she’s here.
lines.zh: 一个小时后，她来了。

lines.en: I’m here.
lines.zh: 我在这里。

lines.en: {i}We’re{/i} here.
lines.zh: {i}我们{/i}在这里。

lines.en: And we hide inside of each other.
lines.zh: 而我们躲进彼此的体内。

lines.en: Then somewhere in the midst of our passion, I see what looks like the early formation of a tear in her left eye.
lines.zh: 然后在缠绵的某个瞬间，我看见她左眼里仿佛有泪水正在成形。

lines.en: She wipes it away and it smears her mascara — but instead of asking “why?” or “what’s wrong?” I just stare into her eyes and try to find more of them.
lines.zh: 她把它抹掉，睫毛膏因此晕开——可我没有问「为什么」或是「怎么了」，只是凝视着她的眼睛，试图找到更多那样的泪。

lines.en: She stares back at me.
lines.zh: 她也回望着我。

lines.en: Then we kiss.
lines.zh: 然后我们接吻。

lines.en: And it is...
lines.zh: 而那是……

lines.en: The most painful thing I have felt in a very long time.
lines.zh: 我很长一段时间以来感受过的最痛苦的事。
